exercises.instruction:
For each situation, write a sentence with should or shouldn't + one of the following:
go away for a few days · stay up so late · look for another job · put some pictures on the walls · take a picture · worry so much

answers: She should go away for a few days.
You should look for another job.

items.prompt: Jack always finds it hard to get up.
answers: He shouldn't stay up so late.
You should take a picture.
She shouldn't worry so much.
He should put some pictures on the walls.

exercises.instruction: Read the situations and write sentences with should / should have / shouldn't / shouldn't have.

items.prompt: I'm feeling sick. I ate too much.
answers: I shouldn't have eaten so much.

items.prompt: When we got to the restaurant, there were no free tables. We hadn't reserved one.
answers: We should have reserved a table.

items.prompt: Laura told me her address, but I didn't write it down. Now I can't remember the house number.
answers: I should have written down her address.
I should have written her address down.
I should have written it down.

items.prompt: The shop is open every day from 8.30. It is 9 o'clock now, but the shop isn't open yet.
answers: The shop should be open by now.
The shop should have opened by now.

items.prompt: I was looking at my phone. I wasn't looking where I was going. I walked into a wall.
answers: I shouldn't have been looking at my phone.
I should have looked where I was going.

items.prompt: Kate is driving. The speed limit is 30 miles an hour, but Kate is doing 50.
answers: She shouldn't be doing 50.
She shouldn't be driving so fast.
She should be driving more slowly.

items.prompt: I wasn't feeling well yesterday, but I went to work. That was a mistake. Now I feel worse.
answers: I shouldn't have gone to work yesterday.

items.prompt: Tomorrow there is a football match between Team A and Team B. Team A are much better.
answers: Team A should win the match.

items.prompt: I was driving. The car in front stopped suddenly and I drove into it. It wasn't my fault.
answers: The driver in front shouldn't have stopped without warning.
The driver in front shouldn't have stopped so suddenly.
